mapper.insert: insert into dispute (order_id, raised_by, reason_type, description, evidence_urls, status, verdict, admin_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderId}, #{raisedBy}, #{reasonType}, #{description}, #{evidenceUrls}, #{status}, #{verdict}, #{adminId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update dispute set status = #{status}, verdict = #{verdict}, admin_id = #{adminId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
